author: yotamleo
body:
## Summary

- Add `himmel-bus` to the existing `node-suites` CI matrix, using Node 24 for its declared engine while other packages remain on Node 22. No new workflow.
- Validate delivery cursors before persistence. Malformed/empty persisted cursors wake `read`, which persists a fail-closed halt and returns one explicit recovery notice instead of crash-looping.
- Add explicit `unhalt` recovery; ordinary commits cannot clear halts, and recovery still verifies the chain. Invalid-cursor recovery can replay from the beginning and is documented.
- Propagate native EACCES/EPERM/EIO and other transient filesystem failures instead of permanently labelling them as tampering.
- Use metadata-only pending checks and one-segment read batches. Append reads at most the latest archive, only for an empty live log. Document committing empty batches and partial-delivery cursors.

## Ticket coverage

- CI runs the store test suite using the existing Node matrix: done
- Malformed delivery/persisted cursor validation and explicit recoverable halt: done
- Native EACCES/EPERM propagate without a wake or permanent tamper halt: done
- Archive content reads bounded to one segment per batch rather than lifetime history: done
- Explicit unhalt path and consumer delivery/recovery documentation: done

## Verification

- Final `npm --prefix marketplace/plugins/himmel-bus test`: **30 passed, 0 failed**, Linux / Node 24.
- RED-first controls reproduced malformed commit acceptance/TypeError, empty cursor JSON crash-loop, swallowed EACCES, archive reads during pending, and critic-found invalid archive metadata crash-loop; all GREEN after implementation.
- Impacted suite reconciliation: **127 suites**, **124 PASS**, **3 SKIP**, **0 missing verdicts**. Every shell suite ran through `scripts/quiet-run.sh`; Node/Bun/Vitest suites ran with their owning runners. Full verdict file is in the leg handover/worktree scratch.
- Skipped only the three remote guest drivers: `test-install-symmetry-vm.sh`, `test-luna-upgrade-vm.sh`, `test-tarball-install-vm.sh`. Their installer/template/release sources are unchanged and no guest was provisioned for this store change. No guest verification is claimed.
- Five unrelated suites failed under inherited lane/proxy configuration, then passed under the repository `clean-sandbox.sh` helper: end-session-wiki, claude-headless, backfill-sessions, crystallize-note, himmel-update-plugin-update. No unrelated fixes made.
- Independent critic round 1 found one Important (invalid archive-number metadata no longer woke `read`); reproduced RED, fixed, class-swept. Round 2 at the final head returned **0 Critical, 0 Important, 0 Suggestions**.
- First commit contains `Platforms tested: linux` and `Security reviewed: manual` attestations. Commit/pre-push gates passed.
- Known-findings' test-coverage checklist is a filename-detector miss: `tests/test-store.mjs` changed with seven behavioral regression tests, but is not a `*.test.*` filename. The suite was run explicitly and is now selected by the Node CI matrix.

## Limits

One segment is the content-read budget, not a hard byte limit: rotation occurs at 256 KiB and one record can overshoot. Directory enumeration remains linear in retained filenames; pruning/indexing and a strict decompression budget are not implemented. Consumed archive contents are not re-audited on every poll. Cursor publication remains process-crash atomic but not fsynced for power loss. Marketplace-cache installation remains HIMMEL-4830's packaging work. No Telegram/bridge source or live state was changed.

CI store proof at PR head `ea2b202aab47b2cd3ee9f39cfc764e458cfeb457`: run `37702911379`, successful [Node 24 bus job](https://github.com/yotamleo/Himmel/actions/runs/37702911379/job/113070363836). The checkout log states `Merge ea2b202aab47b2cd3ee9f39cfc764e458cfeb457 into c1bd37bbffd21aac942e5244b7142cee4d7bcef2`. At `2026-10-07T23:36:06.9161338Z` it runs `node --test tests/test-store.mjs`; at `23:36:07.9668918Z` it reports `pass 30`, followed by `fail 0`. This proves the suite ran, not merely that the matrix contains a row.

Merge is held for console GO and the console-arranged trust judge because this change touches `.github/`.

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/compare/v0.17.21...v0.17.22)

This release is built around finding and organizing things. A new global search palette spans every entity type, hosts and subnets now roll up into collapsible trees, and tags gained groups, icons and colours.

##### New Features

- Add a global search palette on `/` that searches hosts, subnets, VLANs, sites, tags and more from one box ([#​2a2df43](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/2))
- Group hosts by their virtualization tree and nest subnets inside their parents, so hypervisors, guests collapse into readable sections ([#​16df96](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/16))
- Introduce tag groups, letting you define mutually exclusive sets like Status ([#​02e089](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/5))
- Add asset tags to hosts, discovered automatically from ENTITY-MIB or entered by hand ([#​8c5226](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/8))
- Make VLANs taggable and give them a full detail modal showing name, site and tags ([#​86fb61](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/86))

##### Improvements

- Switch lists to table views by default and retire the card view, so every entity list looks and behaves the same ([#da7025](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/7))
- Rework entity modals with consistent layouts, paired short fields, floating icon and tag pickers, and caret navigation to step between entities without closing the dialog ([#fa57f8](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/57))
- Fold bulk actions into the list toolbar and float bulk tagging at the bottom of the list, making multi-select edits easier to reach ([#​4e74bf](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/4))
- Unify page headers with larger titles, sub-tabs in the title row, and a sticky toolbar that keeps result counts and paging in view while you scroll ([#e39be0](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/39))
- Rename Network to Site and if-entries to interfaces throughout the UI for clearer, more familiar terminology ([#f4ef4a](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/4))
- Accept additional OIDC audiences and verify the authorized party, so SSO works with more identity provider configurations ([#e19341](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/19))

##### Bug Fixes

- Fix topology keyboard shortcuts and show the correct key hints for your operating system ([#​36b36e](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/36))
- Persist Docker daemon configuration on its volume so settings survive container restarts and upgrades ([#​0d72c4](https://redirect.github.com/scanopy/scanopy/pull/72))

author: copilot
body:
This change implements a single, explicit process for introducing a term into the portfolio system: canonical definition, admissibility checks, ledger recording, rollout mapping, and lifecycle control. It also embeds an initial candidate term record so the workflow is operational rather than purely descriptive.

- **Canonical governance model**
  - Added `TERM-GOVERNANCE-LEDGER.md` as the source of truth for term lifecycle.
  - Defines required canonical fields (ID, spelling, meaning, owner, scope, date).

- **Admissibility and decision gates**
  - Added pre-admission checks for legal conflict/compliance risk, business notability evidence, and naming alignment.
  - Introduced explicit gate outcomes (`Good / Bad / Ugly`) with mapped actions.

- **Ledger lifecycle + remediation**
  - Defined record schema for admitted terms (`status`, `legal basis`, `evidence links`, `approval timestamp`).
  - Added automated failure handling (`HOLD`, owner flagging, correction package, re-review).
  - Added approval path (`APPROVED`, version lock, periodic revalidation).

- **System embedding + traceability**
  - Added controlled rollout sequence: registry/dictionary update, workflow/rules mapping, audit trail per touchpoint.
  - Added backward/forward validation rules to preserve historical consistency and future inheritance.

- **Seeded working record**
  - Added `TERM-2026-10-07-RODAMATIC` entry with current `HOLD` state, pending legal/evidence fields, and audit trail.

- **Discoverability update**
  - Linked `TERM-GOVERNANCE-LEDGER.md` in `PORTFOLIO-INDEX.md`.

```md
### TERM-2026-10-07-RODAMATIC

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Term ID | `TERM-2026-10-07-RODAMATIC` |
| Spelling | `Rodamatic` |
| Status | `HOLD` |
| Legal basis | Pending documented conflict/compliance review |
| Evidence links | Pending business evidence package |
| Gate result | `BAD` (incomplete evidence) |
```

body:
## Summary

When the standalone catalog has no compatible release or variant, the New Instance wizard advances through empty fields and enables Continue once the optional template field loads. It can then create an installation with no runtime to download.

The wizard now shows an unavailable-runtime message and keeps Continue disabled. The standalone builder and the `add-installation` handler reject missing selections and incomplete runtime metadata before allocating an install directory or writing a record.

Part 1 of 2, split from #1501. Part 2 (stacked on this branch) returns these failures as structured results at every caller instead of thrown errors.

## Feature behavior

- Require standalone release and variant selections. Stop loading dependent fields when either catalog is empty, and guard both Continue and Save.
- Keep empty optional fields working: the ComfyUI-version field on the latest channel and the None template choice.
- Validate runtime version, release tag, variant, Python version and download metadata in `standalone.buildInstallation` and in `add-installation` for `sourceId: 'standalone'`. A non-empty `downloadFiles` list takes precedence over the legacy `downloadUrl`, matching `install()`.
- Accept only `http:`/`https:` download URLs (addresses CodeRabbit's review comment on #1501).
- Other sources and tracking/adoption entry points are unchanged. English and Chinese messages are included.

Until part 2 lands, a builder rejection reaches the renderer as Electron's wrapped invoke error. The wizard shows it on Configure, while Quick Install and express setup catch it in their existing error paths. Every path fails before any installation is created.

- Wizard: empty release and variant catalogs, optional empty fields, channel switching and recovery, and a main-process validation error with no installation added.
- Builder and direct `add-installation`: missing selections, incomplete metadata, malformed and non-http(s) URLs, valid file-list and legacy-URL downloads, and the other source entry points.

body:
## 結論

Gemini 抓錯助手用 160 句題庫外的 Tatoeba 新句子，找到我們程式的錯誤。照你同意的建議修成七組，原本分成 #12、#15～#20 七個 PR。後來 main 也改了分析程式（表頻率、句首 But、連綴動詞 ＋ like ＋ 名詞），題號和待審核編號都撞到，所以整合成這一個 PR，每組的提交紀錄都保留在裡面。舊的七個 PR 可以關掉，各組的說明仍可以在那裡看到。

## 七組修正

| 組 | 內容 | 例子 | 舊 PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 句首副詞子句少了逗號：補一個看不見的逗號重新分析 | *As far as I know the store is closed.*（網站模型原本分析失敗） | #12 |
| 2 | 修飾語功能：表語氣、表時間、固定搭配表對象、as … as 表比較 | *probably*、*in my life*、*linked to*、*as fast as* | #15 |

| 4 | 結構：字面的 out of、插入的 do you think、Why is it that、代替動詞的 do | *ran out of the room*、*What do you think is…?* | #17 |
| 5 | 連綴動詞後面的子句當主詞補語 | *It looks like Tom and Mary are mad.*、*The reason … is because…* | #18 |
| 6 | happen to、can't help but 當助動詞；go ＋ V-ing | *I happened to find…*、*went swimming* | #19 |
| 7 | How long … take you、Which …, A or B?、What a ＋ 名詞 | *Which do you like better, Boston or Chicago?* | #20 |

## 整合時的調整

- **like ＋ 子句**：#18 原本照舊規則標表方式。整合時看到你在第 111 項決定「連綴動詞 ＋ like ＋ 名詞 → 主詞補語」，所以 like 子句也改成主詞補語（句型二），回到我原本給你的建議。

- **轉換程式**：`tests/md_to_yaml.py` 現在認得「同位語・說明X」的寫法，體檢題 md 和 gold 完全同步。

author: francescok
body:
Probed at master `80e28dd29`, macOS, Apple clang 21.

Follows up #7912 ("A route's String stays rooted while a mutator's arguments run"), whose flag-on C comparison showed the root on mutators whose arguments allocate nothing.

```ruby
fz = "frozen-literal-text"
r = (+fz) << "lit"
p r
```

Under `--share-strings`, `(+fz) << "lit"` emitted (master):

```c
lv_r = sp_String_new_shared(({ sp_String *_t1 = sp_String_uplus(lv_fz); SP_GC_ROOT(_t1); sp_String_append(_t1, ((char *)_fzl_1.d)); sp_String_cstr(_t1); }));
```

and a route that can answer nil (`test/string_mutator_expr_receiver.rb`) rooted twice:

```c
({ sp_String *_t67 = ({ sp_String *_t66 = _t65; SP_GC_ROOT(_t66); if (SP_UNLIKELY(!_t66)) sp_raise_nomethod(...); _t66; }); SP_GC_ROOT(_t67); sp_String_append(_t67, ((char *)_fzl_22.d)); sp_String_cstr(_t67); })
```

With this PR:

```c
lv_r = sp_String_new_shared(({ sp_String *_t1 = sp_String_uplus(lv_fz); sp_String_append(_t1, ((char *)_fzl_1.d)); sp_String_cstr(_t1); }));
({ sp_String *_t67 = ({ sp_String *_t66 = _t65; if (SP_UNLIKELY(!_t66)) sp_raise_nomethod(...); _t66; }); sp_String_append(_t67, ((char *)_fzl_22.d)); sp_String_cstr(_t67); })
```

The output is the same before and after; the change removes roots nothing needs.

- #7912 roots the temp that holds a route's handle (`emit_route_recv_root`) for every mutator, because a route can answer a String of its own that nothing else holds while the mutator's arguments allocate.
- An append, `replace` and `setbyte` allocate nothing of their own: `sp_String_append` and `sp_String_set_bin` grow the handle's payload with `malloc` (`sp_fd_grow`, `sp_fd_grow_inline`), and `sp_str_setbyte_cow` writes a handle's payload (marker 0xfd) in place. With literal or local arguments nothing can collect while the temp is live.
- The nil test `strbuf_route_recv` wraps around a route that can answer nil roots its own temp. `SP_GC_ROOT` is block-scoped (`lib/sp_gc.h`: a cleanup-attribute variable pops the root when its declaring scope ends), so that root ends with the wrapper's statement expression, before the mutator runs. Inside the wrapper nothing allocates but the raise, where the temp is nil.

**The root follows what can allocate.** `emit_route_recv_root` now takes the mutator's operands. It leaves the root out when every operand has the type the mutator reads without a conversion (a String for an append or `replace`, an Integer for `setbyte`) and `operand_may_allocate` says it cannot allocate (a literal, a local). An Integer appended as its character (`sp_int_codepoint_to_str_in`), a boxed operand, `prepend` (`sp_str_concat`), `append_as_bytes`, `bytesplice` and the bang methods that build their result keep the root, as does the statement-level shim.

**The nil wrapper's root goes.** It never covered the mutator. The temp the mutator holds is rooted by the rule above when something can allocate.

**Why it is safe.** In every arm that loses the root, the C between the handle's read and its last use is the handle's own growth (`malloc`/`realloc`, no collection), a frozen check and a nil check that raise (the temp is then dead), and the operands, which `operand_may_allocate` clears. That is the test the operand-rooting code already relies on to leave a sibling temp unrooted (`codegen_call_operator.c`, `codegen_call_recv.c`).

**Corpus C diff.** On CI, against master `80e28dd29`, over 6,478 programs: the default build's C is unchanged apart from the build stamp in `RUBY_DESCRIPTION` (4 programs). Under `--share-strings` one corpus program differs, `test/string_mutator_expr_receiver.rb`, by exactly the two removed roots shown above; no refusal changes (71 are refused by both).

A local sample of 350 String, mutator and share programs (`-S --no-line-map`, flag off and on, against master `80e28dd29`) changes 4 programs, all only under the flag, and only by removed `SP_GC_ROOT` lines: `test/string_mutator_expr_receiver.rb` and `test/share/share_strings_catch_throw.rb` (one append each), `test/share/share_strings_method_values.rb` (three appends) and `test/share/share_strings_value_routes.rb` (appends, a `replace` and a `setbyte` with literal arguments; its `upcase!` and `[]=` routes keep their outer root and lose only the wrapper's). The default build's C is byte-identical over the sample. `test/byref_string_arg_in_rescue_method.rb` and `test/string_handle_param_nil_default.rb` keep the nil checks from #7912 and emit the same C as on master.

**Tests.** `test/share/share_strings_route_args.rb` adds, 40 times over, `(+fz) << "lit"`, `(+fz).replace("other")` and `(+fz).setbyte(0, 72)` (now unrooted), and `(+fz) << 65` and `(+fz).concat(i.to_s * 200, "!")` (still rooted: a conversion, and an argument that allocates). author: clayshentrup
body:
## What

A name node already keeps a `Resolution`: 0 until it first runs, 1 for a local, and a stamp for a global. It now also keeps where a local's binding sat: `3 + 256 × frames-above + slot`. That value lies between plain local and the global stamps.

- **On a hit**, a later run follows that many parent pointers, compares the one name in the slot, and takes the value.
- **On a miss**, it walks the frames as `lookup` always did and keeps the new place.
- **Deep frames**: a frame deeper than 127 or a slot past 255 keeps plain local and always walks.

The existing global stamp rests on the frames a node sees being fixed by where the node sits in the text. This relies on the same property. Debug builds check every kept place against a full walk, so the specs check it on every program they carry.

## Evidence

**Interpreted corpus, this container.** Main reads the row exactly on its golden here, at 585,141,444.

| row | main | branch | change |
|---|---|---|---|
| interp_instructions | 585,141,444 | 573,873,591 | -11,267,853 (-1.93%) |

- `lookup` was 654,409 calls at 69 instructions each. `lookup_at` is about 45 a call, most of it the clone of the returned value.
- The interpreter's output is byte-identical.
- `interp_memory` agrees with its golden.
- `all_compile.sh` reports every compile vein AGREED except `codegen_instructions`. That row counts only the clang child processes, and it reads this container's own figures exactly as main does here. The golden stays at CI's value.
- `browser_cost` passes.

**Suite.**
- The full debug suite passes. The two wasm binaries needed `docs/kanso.wasm` built in the new worktree.
- The trend gate and `all_pages.sh` pass.
- Welfare is banked at 90.05.

**Ratchet.** The new row `local_place` makes every reference keep plain local. Under it the row reads 613,859,041, red against the golden.

## Rulings weighed

STATUS.md's "Ruled, unbuilt" lists three rows:
- **list/tie** and **the browser in the objective** are built.
- **A welfare counter reads three parts per billion** stands as a measurement question. Main reads the interpreter row exactly on its golden in this container, so this change doesn't bear on it.

This came first because runbench's remaining margins, profiled today in both the decoder and the encoder, need a larger change than any one function. The interpreter row had a single function at 7% of its profile.

author: austinywang
body:
## Summary

Em dashes and ellipses immediately after CJK text could overlap the next character, as in `看——Ghostty` and `你……好`. Update Ghostty so punctuation uses the font selected by the resolver, preserving its one-cell glyph instead of substituting the preceding CJK face's full-width glyph. Explicit punctuation codepoint maps now retain their selected font too.

The fork change is https://github.com/manaflow-ai/ghostty/pull/265, based on cmux's existing `01f4e0fe2` pin. Bidi direction and visual order remain owned by itijah.

## Testing

- Zig formatting and diff checks passed.
- Regression-only run: https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux/actions/runs/37702657286 reproduced the bug: 73/74 tests passed; the new test failed because the shaper chose PingFang index 3 instead of the resolved primary index 0.
- Fixed-head CJK regression: 74/74 passed. Full native CoreText shaper suite on the macOS 15 test runner: 122/122 passed, with no skipped tests. GhosttyKit built and published successfully in https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux/actions/runs/37702833993.
- The regression checks JetBrains Mono + PingFang SC with an explicit fallback, a CJK map, and a punctuation map. It covers the reported strings, spaces/Latin/line-start controls, and cursor/selection boundaries.
- Downloaded and validated the published GhosttyKit archive; pinned SHA-256 `edc3f83d1c196310c4db643db5bc6a7e77b9a495a65361596776a84a988de7b0`. The checksum-presence guard passes.
- All 16 applicable local verification checks passed.
- Correctness-first subagent review found no concrete bugs; findings and validation limits are recorded in https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux/pull/18469#issuecomment-6049001369.
- Exact-head tagged app build `089d28806fdaf6ea58917848` succeeded for `9fdded00b7517939122933a768d6f828d76574b5` on `cmux12s-Mac-mini.local`. [Open the dogfood build](http://127.0.0.1:17320/pr-18469-cjk-punctuation-v1). App tag and isolated bundle identity were validated during publication. All 64 PR checks are now green.
- Live visual verification completed on the exact-head tagged app using the advertised repro; the screenshot showed each em dash and ellipsis staying within its allocated cell before the following CJK or Latin text. HarfBuzz backend execution remains unverified.

## Changelog

Fixed: Em dashes and ellipses after CJK text no longer switch to an overlapping full-width fallback glyph.

## Issues

Closes https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux/issues/10733.

## Issue lifecycle

Pickup: https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux/issues/10733#issuecomment-6048912954. Resolution remains pending until merge.

## Impact map

The font resolver owns font selection; the shared run iterator now preserves it in both the visual boundary scan and logical contents pass. CoreText and HarfBuzz consume those runs, and the renderer consumes their grid clusters. Terminal cell widths, stored text, config syntax, and fallback font sizing are unchanged. The main residual risk is different punctuation run boundaries in other scripts; the full shaper test filter covers the adjacent Arabic, Hebrew, combining-mark, Hangul, ligature, and sprite paths. No user-facing strings require localization.

## Dogfood

With a JetBrains Mono primary font and PingFang SC fallback, run `printf '你——好\n你……好\n看——Ghostty\n你 —— 好\nab——cd\n——你好\n'`. Dashes and ellipses should stay in their allocated cells without overlapping the following glyphs.

Conflict-only gate: PASS, no conflicted paths.

- Head: `9fdded00b7517939122933a768d6f828d76574b5`

author: yhgrwav
body:
What: `app.connections` is read from its text, the same way `rps` is: trimmed, quotes at the ends removed, a whole number from 1 to 256. A refused value is printed as written in the error: `2.0`, `two`, `0x10`, not the number the parser made of it. `connections: "2"` is 2; `0x10` is refused; no value or null is 1 as before.

Why: `connections: 2.0` was refused with "...: 2", a whole number in range, and the user could not see why.

How checked: new tests in pkg/config/connections_test.go (refused as written, quoted number, no value / null / ~); `make check`; `go test ./pkg/config ./cmd/leettest ./examples/...`. Mutations (message prints the parsed number, quotes not stripped, a missing value is an error, upper bound >= 256, lower bound raised to 2) each fail a test.

body:
## 概要

`docs/261001_fix_user_feedback_ui.md` の **L1**（§6.8.5）です。アプリの「路線」を、国土数値情報 S12 の**法令上の路線**ではなく、利用者が呼ぶ路線（**運行系統**）で持つためのデータを作り、DB に入れました。

S12 の「山手線」は 17 駅（品川〜新宿〜田端）で、東京・上野・秋葉原は入っていません。この PR で、駅データ.jp（有料版・2024-04-26）から **JR山手線＝30 駅**のような路線と駅の対応を作ります。画面・AI・共通 API はまだ使いません（L2〜L4）。

| 路線 | S12（法令上） | この PR の路線 |
|---|---|---|
| 山手線 | 17 駅（東京・上野・秋葉原が無い） | **JR山手線 30 駅**（環状） |
| 中央線（快速） | 東京駅を含まず神田〜名古屋 111 駅 | **JR中央線(快速) 24 駅**（東京〜高尾） |
| 副都心線 | 11 駅 | **16 駅**（和光市・地下鉄成増・地下鉄赤塚を含む） |
| 京浜東北線 | 名前の路線が無い | **36 駅**（大宮〜横浜。根岸線は別の路線） |

## 変更

- `pipeline/line_rules.py`：**手で編集するのはここだけ**。名前の直し 16・駅の追加 2（夢洲・仙巌園）・結べなくてよい駅（臨時駅）・駅データ.jp に無い S12 の路線（ケーブルカー 16・ディズニーリゾートライン）・人が確かめた事業者 → 会社名（5 社）・固定の確認 13 路線・OSM の系統 12
- `pipeline/build_lines.py`：駅レコード（路線 × 駅）を、駅名の鍵が同じで 1.5km 以内のアプリの駅へ結ぶ。候補が複数なら**会社名 → 駅名の完全一致 → 近さ**

## 計画から変えたこと

1. **候補の選び方を「会社名 → 完全一致 → 近さ」に**（計画は完全一致が先）。完全一致が先だと、島原鉄道の「諫早」が JR の「諫早」に当たる。両方の順で全レコードを比べ、違いはこの 1 件だけ・会社名が先が正しいことを確かめた
2. **取り違え 3 件を直しの表に足した**：東京モノレールの浜松町 → モノレール浜松町、伊予鉄道の路面電車の大手町 → 大手町駅前、神戸高速東西線の三宮 → 阪急の神戸三宮。直しの表は 18 行（計画時の見込みは 15）
3. **事業者 → 会社名は、割合 0.95 未満なら人が確かめた表を必須に**。多数決だけだと線路の持ち主の神戸高速鉄道が「阪神電気鉄道」になる。相模鉄道（0.87）などは対応が正しくても割合が低いので、割合では分けられない
4. **新駅の検出は「前回の投入」から増えた駅で**（「前回の build」だと、検証が落ちて作り直したときに新駅が消える）
